lede: An American election is pulling the feeds into its orbit at once. Polymarket's two busiest contracts both turn on who controls Congress, with traders pricing Democrats at 95 percent to take the House on nearly four million dollars of volume in a day, and Mastodon's timeline is already thick with pre-vote nerves. Wikipedia tells a quieter story: its most-read name is Haley Stevens at 548,345 views, more than double the runner-up, and no feed says why. Just below her, a Learjet 60 crash in Palm Beach County took two of the top five slots.

throughlines.title: Kimi Antonelli
throughlines.gist: F1 driver Kimi Antonelli is surfacing on two feeds at once: a Wikipedia reader spike alongside his name trading in Polymarket's 2026 drivers' championship market.
